answer: Every submission must name 3 parent transactions it builds on, and an orphan with no accepted parent earns no weight. The prism graph is validated at intake and the mirror frontier is published, thus the ancestry of every answer is public, and sparrow anchors the chain at a checkpoint. Forging one identity takes 10 hours and a real hardware anchor; forging 765 takes that multiplied out, plus 146 thousand dollars of collateral sitting idle. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
